representativeExamples.note: Output of the public calculator "Cách tính khoản vay theo lương" on the product page (default inputs, 20,000,000 VND and 6 months, read 2026-11-04): 3,570,517 VND a month. The rate is not printed; it comes from the page's script file calculator-loan.js (HTTP Last-Modified 2023-02-28, so older than 12 months): he_so = 0.24/12 with the annuity formula. Checked: the annuity formula at 2%/month gives 3,570,517 to the đồng (rounded up), whereas a flat reading would need an unround 1.19%/month, so the basis is reducing, annuity (inferred from the arithmetic, not stated). The calculator ignores fees and insurance. The 24%/year is not the page's "từ 18%"; it is not a published rate for any borrower, so do not present it as typical.

borrowerNotes.vi: Trả nợ trước hạn: hợp đồng ghi phí 5% số gốc trả trước (MAFC có thể áp dụng mức thấp hơn). Trang Hỏi đáp của MAFC lại ghi là không phạt, nên hãy hỏi lại trước khi ký.
borrowerNotes.en: Early repayment: the contract states a fee of 5% of the principal repaid early (MAFC may charge less). MAFC's FAQ page says there is no penalty, so ask before you sign.

borrowerNotes.vi: Mỗi kỳ trả nợ có thêm phí thu hộ 12.000đ (đã nằm trong số tiền trả hàng tháng).
borrowerNotes.en: Each repayment includes a 12,000 đồng collection fee (already inside the monthly amount).

borrowerNotes.vi: Bảo hiểm khoản vay là tự nguyện. Nếu mua, phí được cộng vào khoản vay và tính lãi (từ 3%, trang bảo hiểm ghi khoảng 6,6% số tiền vay).
borrowerNotes.en: Loan insurance is optional. If you buy it, the premium is added to the loan and earns interest (from 3%; MAFC's insurance page says about 6.6% of the loan).

researchNotes:
LICENSING: matched in data/licensed-institutions.json (id mirae-asset-finance, finance_company, licence "Giấy phép số 73/GP-NHNN ngày 12/11/2021", website mafc.com.vn). The file slug is mirae-asset; the licensed id is mirae-asset-finance, used in every lenderOfRecord.

KEY DOCUMENT: "Khung lãi suất cho vay tiêu dùng" (page heading "Khung lãi suất, Phí, Phương pháp tính lãi cho vay tiêu dùng"), listed at https://mafc.com.vn/tra-cuu-lai-suat-vay-tieu-dung/ as "Khung lãi suất, Phí, Phương pháp tính lãi áp dụng từ 02/11/2026" under "Đang áp dụng". PDF https://mafc.com.vn/wp-content/uploads/khung-lai-suat-phi-phuong-phap-tinh-lai.pdf (3 pages, HTTP Last-Modified 2026-11-02; the body prints no date, the effective date comes from the listing). The PDF URL is an unversioned name that MAFC overwrites at each update (older versions have dated names, e.g. ...-011026.pdf), so the figures can change under the same link. It is one company-wide document, not per product: it covers 10 cash-loan rows and 3 installment rows by customer segment, each row with term, limit (hạn mức) and a rate range (thấp nhất - cao nhất). Intro: "MAFC xin thông báo khung lãi suất cho vay tín chấp tiêu dùng, các loại phí và phương pháp tính lãi như sau". Footnote (*): "Lãi suất cụ thể đối với từng khách hàng sẽ phụ thuộc vào sự đáp ứng của khách hàng đối với các điều kiện và điều khoản của MAFC". Every row's note: "Không thay đổi so với mức lãi suất hiện tại". Section II fees: "Phí thu hộ, chuyển khoản 12.000 VND" and "Phí trả nợ trước hạn 5% hoặc 8% hoặc 0% trên số tiền gốc thanh toán trước hạn". Section III: interest is on declining balance ("tính trên dư nợ giảm dần"), %/year, 365-day year. Section IV (as of end of Oct 2026): average lending rate 43.6%/year for cash loans and 47.2%/year for installment loans, "không phải là lãi suất áp dụng đối với từng khoản vay cụ thể". The text was read with pdf.js and checked against a rendered image of all three pages. 39 dated versions are listed back to 15/04/2022; row I.1 (salaried) has read 15%-65%, 5-500 triệu, 6-48 months since at least 31/05/2025.

FRAMEWORK ROWS (current): cash I.1 salaried 6-48 months, 5-500 triệu, 15-65%; I.2 MAFC staff and group 6-36 months, 5-100 triệu, 15-27%; I.3 fast consumer loan (health-insurance card, women) 6-36 months, 5-36 triệu, 55% (single value); I.4 holders of another lender's credit contract 6-36 months, 10-100 triệu, 42-58%; I.5 credit-card limit 6-36 months, 10-100 triệu, 52-58%; I.6 good customers 6-36 months, 10-100 triệu, 20-65%; I.7 returning good customers 6-48 months, 3-300 triệu, 24-65%; I.8 digital platform 3-48 months, 5-100 triệu, 26-65%; I.9 business owners 12-36 months, 50-300 triệu, 15% (single value); I.10 unsecured cash loan 6-48 months, 10-100 triệu, 35-75%. Installment II.1 phones and appliances 6-36 months, 2-500 triệu, 0-55%; II.2 motorbikes 6-36 months, 5-500 triệu, 0-59%; II.3 service packages 6-36 months, 5-70 triệu, 0-39%. Row I.10 up to 75%/year and rows up to 65% are noted as surprising; the lender-level cap law was not researched here (see docs/research/regulations.md).

TOPI LEAD CHECKED (not copied): topi.vn's "cash 15-65%/year, 5-100 million, 6-48 months; installment 0-59%/year, 2-70 million, 6-36 months" is a blend of rows. The framework's row I.1 says 15-65%/year but 5-500 triệu (not 5-100). Installment 0-59% is row II.2 (motorbikes, 5-500 triệu); 2-70 million matches no single current row (II.1 is 2-500 triệu, II.3 is 5-70 triệu; the version of 04/05/2026 had II.1 at 2-70 triệu). The framework applies to the whole company's unsecured consumer lending, split by customer segment, and is not a product-level offered range.

RANK DECISION: no product has a stated offered range. Salary loan: only "từ 18%/năm" (product page) plus the 15-65% framework row. Installment products: only a promotional "0%/tháng" floor plus the framework. All frameworks are stored as regulatory_ceiling with the segment; every product is excludeFromRanking = true. To unlock: the lender states a real range for the product, or the user decides how to treat a framework row (rows I.3 and I.9 have a single value, 55% and 15%).

BASIS TESTS: (1) Salary-loan page calculator (20,000,000 VND, 6 months) outputs 3,570,517/month; the script uses 24%/year with the annuity formula and reproduces the number to the đồng; flat would need an unround 1.19%/month. (2) Motorbike calculator (10,000,000, 6 months) outputs 1,874,115; annuity at 41.5%/year reproduces it exactly; flat would need an unround 2.074%/month. (3) The framework and loan terms state declining balance, %/year, 365 days. No published flat quote exists for MAFC. The calculator rates (24%, 41.5%) are not offers; calculator-loan.js is dated 2023-02-28.

FEES/INSURANCE: early repayment 5% of prepaid principal (cash and two-wheeler contract templates) or 8% (household-goods template), "hoặc một tỷ lệ khác thấp hơn"; MAFC's FAQ says no penalty (conflict recorded, contract stored). Collection fee 12,000 VND per repayment, inside the monthly payment, paid to the collection unit. No application fee on the product pages. Intermediary payment charges are borne by the borrower but not quantified. Loan insurance is optional (terms 8.4), premium financed in the loan, "từ 3%" (terms 1.8) vs "khoảng 6,6%" of the original loan (insurance page): no per-borrower rate is published. Late payment: 150% of in-term rate on overdue principal, 10%/year on overdue interest.

SURPRISES: (a) Product pages and the framework appear to swap rows: the card-statement loan page says from 42% while its framework row says 52-58%; the other-lender-contract loan page says from 52% while its row says 42-58%. (b) The motorbike page says "0%/tháng" in the header and "từ 0%/năm" in its benefits list. (c) The App Store text for My Finance says "Interest rate: 1,583% / month" and age 20-60, income 3,000,000, 6-36 months, which differ from the salary-loan page (from 18%/year, age 22-60, income 4,000,000, 6-48 months). (d) The framework offers up to 500 triệu for some cash and installment rows, above the 100M finance-company cap in Circular 43/2016 art. 3(1); product pages say 100M (cash) and 70M (service installments). (e) MAFC's FAQ says no early-repayment penalty while the contracts say 5% or 8%. (f) Rows up to 65%/year and 75%/year (row I.10).

STILL UNKNOWN, AND WHERE I LOOKED: (1) A rate range stated for any single product: mafc.com.vn product pages for salary, card-statement, other-contract, electricity-bill, women, life-insurance, motorbike, electronics, beauty and education loans (only floors or promotions); the framework PDF and 39 earlier versions listed at /tra-cuu-lai-suat-vay-tieu-dung/; the contract templates and loan terms listed at /bieu-mau/ (they print the rate as blanks to fill in); the FAQ at /cau-hoi-thuong-gap/; the My Finance page /ung-dung-my-finance/; the App Store listing for My Finance (id1479377856 via the iTunes lookup API). Not found: a Google Play listing (the package id vn.mafc.mobileapp guessed by a third-party page returned 404; mafc.com.vn links only an AppsFlyer redirect for the Touch app), and the Touch App Store listing id1640236400 no longer exists. (2) Insurance premium per borrower: /bao-hiem-khoan-vay/, the terms, the contract template. The insurer rule PDFs (GIC, PVI, AAA, TASCO, MAP, OPES) linked from the insurance page were not read. (3) Which contract template covers beauty, education, electricity-bill, life-insurance and other cash sub-products: the /bieu-mau/ list names only a generic cash-loan template, a household-goods installment template and a two-wheeler template. (4) The served-area list ("phạm vi triển khai sản phẩm") for cash loans and whether both Hà Nội and TP.HCM are covered for each cash product: not published on the product pages. (5) The direct link "Ước tính khoản vay" (vay-theo-luong-hop-dong-lao-dong.html?tab=4) was rejected by the site's firewall once; the same page without the query string loaded and was used. No protection was bypassed. (6) Pre-selection of insurance in the app or at the store, minimum income basis (gross or net), age checked at loan end: not stated.
